Use this API call to create a Klarna Payments session.
When a session is created you will receive the available `payment_method_categories` for the session, a `session_id` and a `client_token`. The `session_id` can be used to read or update the session using the REST API. The `client_token` should be passed to the browser. Read more on **[Create a new payment session](https://docs.klarna.com/klarna-payments/integrate-with-klarna-payments/step-1-initiate-a-payment/)**.
